h1: Hop Inn Kamphaeng Phet — A Brand-New Budget Chain Hotel That's the Best Value in Kamphaeng Phet Town
intro: If you're stopping in Kamphaeng Phet for errands, breaking up a northern road trip, or using it as a base before exploring the historical park, and you want a clean room at a price you don't have to think twice about, the name many people pick is Hop Inn Kamphaeng Phet · A budget chain hotel from Thailand's Erawan Group that holds the same standard nationwide — plain, clean rooms with everything you actually need and nothing extra · This is a recently opened branch, so the rooms are still brand-new · Real-review score is a high 9.4 from 47 reviews on Trip.com, with location and cleanliness rated around 9.5–9.6 · Rooms start from approx. ฿700/night

body.html: Hop Inn Kamphaeng Phet is a budget chain hotel from Hop Inn, part of Thailand's Erawan Group, which runs more than 70 budget properties across the country · It sits on Ratchawithi Road in Kamphaeng Phet town, on the same side as the Asian Highway that northbound traffic uses · The chain's selling point is clear: the same standard rooms at every branch — clean, plain, with everything you need and a price you can predict · Travellers stopping in Kamphaeng Phet for errands, an overnight on a long drive, or as a base before visiting the historical park tend to pick it because they know exactly what they'll get.

Rooms come as Standard Twin (two single beds) and Standard Double (one double bed) · Each has AC, a flat-screen TV, a work desk, and a private bathroom with a hot-water shower · Because this is a recently opened branch, the praise you see most often is that the rooms are still brand-new, very clean, the beds comfortable, and the AC cold · The decor is minimal and plain in the brand's white-and-yellow scheme, with little in the way of styling — anyone after a pretty, design-led room may find it bare, but for travellers who just want a clean room to sleep in, this is exactly what Hop Inn does well and consistently.
"Brand-new and spotless, comfortable bed, cold AC, strong hot water, cheap, friendly staff, easy parking, great location near the mall — I'll stay here again next time I'm in Kamphaeng Phet."

Facilities are the pared-back budget kind, focused on the essentials · There's free parking, free Wi-Fi, a 24-hour front desk, an elevator and CCTV · The thing to accept up front is that this is a budget hotel, so there's no pool, no gym and no full restaurant, and the walls are only moderately soundproofed — a few reviews mention hearing a neighbour's alarm or sounds from the next room in the morning · There's no in-house breakfast either, but there are plenty of restaurants and convenience stores within easy reach.

The location is right in Kamphaeng Phet town · A short walk or drive gets you to Robinson Lifestyle, Big C, Makro and the Chakangrao night bazaar, the town's main eating and shopping spots · It's a short drive from the UNESCO-listed Kamphaeng Phet Historical Park, Wat Phra Kaeo and the Kamphaeng Phet National Museum · It suits self-drivers well thanks to easy parking and a position right on a main road · The overall real-review score sits around 9.4, with Trip.com giving roughly 9.4 from 47 reviews — a very high number for a budget hotel, helped in part by how new the rooms still are.

To be straight with you, Hop Inn Kamphaeng Phet isn't the place for a resort feel or a full set of facilities · There's no pool, no gym, no riverfront view, the rooms are plain, and the soundproofing is only adequate · If you're coming to Kamphaeng Phet to fully relax or you want a river-view room, this won't deliver · But if what you want is a new, clean, comfortable, safe room with easy parking, close to the mall, at a low and predictable price — Hop Inn Kamphaeng Phet does that very well and is genuinely good value in the context of a stopover town.

A tip from reading through the reviews: ask for a higher floor or a room away from the main corridor if you're worried about noise, since the walls are only moderately soundproofed and there are reviews about a neighbour's morning alarm · There's no breakfast here, but it's an easy walk to the market or the food options around the mall · Booking direct through the Hop Inn app sometimes matches the platforms on price, but it's still worth comparing with Agoda and Booking each time, as rates shift by season.

honestSummary: Hop Inn Kamphaeng Phet is the best value for travellers who want a new, clean, comfortable, safe room with easy parking, close to the mall, at a low and predictable price in Kamphaeng Phet town · Location, cleanliness and value are genuine strengths, and the review score is very high for a budget hotel — partly because the rooms are still new — but you have to accept plain rooms, no pool or gym, no in-house breakfast, and only adequate soundproofing.
honestChecks: If you want a resort feel or a riverfront-view room — there's no pool, gym or river view here → pick a riverfront hotel like Chakungrao Riverview or Scenic Riverside in Kamphaeng Phet instead.

If you're a light sleeper sensitive to noise — the walls are only moderately soundproofed and some reviews mention a neighbour's morning alarm → ask for a higher floor or a room away from the main corridor, and pack earplugs.
If you need in-house breakfast — there's no breakfast on site → there are restaurants and a market within easy reach, or pick a hotel that includes breakfast if you must have it.
